blendsheet_data.title: Blend Sheets
blendsheet_data.description: Add one entry per blend sheet. Each entry mirrors one printed SLTB Blend Sheet.

form.title: Form
form.description: Printed top-right of the blend sheet. Not carried by the XML — select manually.

blendsheet_no.title: Blend Sheet No.
blendsheet_no.description: Assigned when the application is submitted.

exporter_registration_no.title: Exporter Reg. No.
exporter_registration_no.description: SLTB exporter registration number as printed on the blend sheet.

private_treaty_to_be_exported.title: To Be Exported To
private_treaty_to_be_exported.description: Destination country named in the blend sheet declaration.

cusdec_number.title: CUSDEC Reg No.
cusdec_number.description: Office, year, serial and number as printed on the blend sheet.

grade_or_standard.title: Grade/Standard
grade_or_standard.description: Blend grade as declared, e.g. BOPF, BOP, PF1, FGS1, PF.

lion_logo_requested.title: Logo Lion
lion_logo_requested.description: Select 'Yes' if this blend sheet requires SLTB Lion Logo certification.

sales.title: PARTICULAR OF SALE
sales.description: Please upload the official sale sheet containing the detailed blend analysis (.xlsx, .xls, .csv)

x-evaluate.label: Average Value Per KG (Total Value ÷ Total Quantity)

imported_tea.title: PARTICULAR OF IMPORTED TEA
imported_tea.description: Please upload the official import sheet containing the detailed import analysis (.xlsx, .xls, .csv)

blend_balances.title: PARTICULARS OF BLEND BALANCES USED (IF APPLICABLE)
blend_balances.description: Please upload the official blend balances sheet containing the detailed blend analysis (.xlsx, .xls, .csv)

total_blend_balances_and_gain.title: Total (Blend Balances & Gain) (KG)
total_blend_balances_and_gain.description: Total Blend Balances and Gain = Total Blend Balances + Total Blend Gain

remarks.title: Remarks
remarks.description: Filled from the blend sheet XML when one is imported; otherwise enter manually.
remarks.example: This is a sample remark for the blend sheet.

sample_rediness_date.title: Sample Readiness Date
sample_rediness_date.description: Filled from the blend sheet XML when one is imported; otherwise enter manually.

warehouse_address.title: Warehouse Address
warehouse_address.description: Filled from the blend sheet XML when one is imported; otherwise enter manually.
warehouse_address.example: Quick Tea (Pvt) Ltd, 119, 119/1 Attampolawatte, Mabole, Wattala

blend_gain_determined.title: Blend Gain Determined (KG)
blend_gain_determined.description: Filled from the blend sheet XML when one is imported; otherwise enter manually.

flavors.title: Flavors (KG)
flavors.description: Filled from the blend sheet XML when one is imported; otherwise enter manually.

total.title: Total (KG)
total.description: Total Quantity = Total Sales + Total Imported + Total Blend Balances and Gain

avg_value_per_kg.title: Avg Value Per KG
avg_value_per_kg.description: Declared average value per KG as printed in the blend sheet footer. May differ from the value-weighted average derived from the sale table.

quantity_to_be_shipped_imported.title: Quantity to be Shipped — Imported (KG)
quantity_to_be_shipped_imported.description: Filled from the blend sheet XML when one is imported; otherwise enter manually.

quantity_to_be_shipped_local.title: Quantity to be Shipped — Local (KG)
quantity_to_be_shipped_local.description: Filled from the blend sheet XML when one is imported; otherwise enter manually.

blend_balance.title: Blend Balance C/F (KG)
blend_balance.description: Blend Balance = Total Quantity - Quantity to be Exported

cusdec_draft.title: CusDec
cusdec_draft.description: The draft CusDec for this application, as the trader submitted it.

manifestRegNumber.title: 5. Manifest/Voyage Ref ( Box A )
manifestRegNumber.description: Manifest or voyage registration reference. Optional.

declarationMode.title: 3. Declaration Mode ( Box A )
declarationMode.description: Always E (electronic) for declarations submitted through the single window.

transportNationality.title: 19. Vessel/Flight Nationality ( Box 18 )
transportNationality.description: Country code of the vessel/aircraft at departure.

modeOfTransport.title: 32. Mode of Transport at Border ( Box 25 )

placeOfDischargeCode.title: 33. Place of Discharging ( Box 27 )
placeOfDischargeCode.description: UNLOCODE of the place where the goods are discharged.

remittanceAmount.title: 56. Remittance Amount
remittanceAmount.description: Amount remitted through the bank against this declaration.

marksAndNumbers.title: 39. Marks & Nos of Packages ( Box 31 )
marksAndNumbers.example: LL-00-Sir Williams Brand | 1 X 40' HC FCL

scannedDocuments.title: Scanned Documents
scannedDocuments.description: Scanned PDFs for the SCAN DOC tab in the CusDec. Up to 300 KB each.

metaDocuments.title: Meta Documents
metaDocuments.description: Documents referenced by code and reference number (no scan).

itemSequence.title: Item Number
itemSequence.description: Item number in the declaration that this document applies to, e.g. 8 for the 8th item.

documentId.title: Document Reference Number
documentId.description: Reference of a document already held elsewhere.

elements.text: PARTICULARS OF THE TEA BOUGHT AT THE COLOMBO TEA AUCTION AND PRIVATE TREATY TO BE EXPORTED TO
AS UNBLENDED STRAIGHT LINES/BLEND BULK/PACKETS/TEA IN TEA BAGS

options.description: Import a CusDec XML to fill in the form, or enter the declaration by hand.
